Craft Tools

You unroll the worn cloth and set each trusted tool within reach.

Rules

- ID: item-craft-tools - Bulk: 1 - Requirements / supply: Reusable - Acquisition: Explicit ability grant, coins, or DA treasure; no automatic extra starting kit.

Required for recipes that list them; no inventory die.

No DP price. Purchase does not grant training or an ability.

Equipment index

Market price: 15 coins. Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
